quizzes.question_text:
This compound figure is made up of two rectangles joined together.
The larger rectangle measures 26 yards wide and 18 yards tall.
The smaller rectangle measures 4 yards wide and 6 yards tall.
What is the area of this figure?
___ square yards
solution: Divide the figure into rectangles:
Start with rectangle A. Rectangle A is 26 yards wide and 18 yards tall.
Multiply:\n$26 \times 18 = 468$\nThe area of rectangle A is 468 square yards.
Look at rectangle B. Rectangle B is 4 yards wide and 6 yards tall.
Multiply:\n$4 \times 6 = 24$\nThe area of rectangle B is 24 square yards.
Now add the areas of the two rectangles:\n$468 + 24 = 492$
The area is 492 square yards.
